Once this ticket merges, Check keeps a drifted file's existing purpose and does not call the model, so Check will never reword that header either. Re-scope: drop the header-reword item, or have a human edit the header outside Implement.

Put the empty-owner and stale-relates preservation check in its own test function. A second Check sends the file through generic meta.refresh, which rewrites owner to `engine` and drops the stale relation, so that fixture cannot also serve as the clean-rerun guard.
